query:
SELECT 
  (SELECT AVG(LENGTH(r.body)) 
   FROM reviews r 
   JOIN products p ON p.category='office products' AND p.ref_id=r.ref_id AND p.status='active' 
   WHERE r.verification_label IS NULL AND r.body IS NOT NULL) - 
  (SELECT AVG(LENGTH(r.body)) 
   FROM reviews r 
   JOIN products p ON p.category='office products' AND p.ref_id=r.ref_id AND p.status='active' 
   WHERE r.verification_label IS NOT NULL AND r.body IS NOT NULL)
